title: Quantization of the Cosmic Critical Density
content: In this paper we study the quantization of the cosmic critical density. Applying a generalized relational expression, we derive a quantized formula for the cosmic critical density and subsequently prove. We compare a graph of the three components of the formula, it reveals that the gravitational quantization term dominates during the very early universe and near the Planck time, suggesting it may be a consequence of a complete theory of quantum gravity. Our discussion is intriguing and heuristically valuable.
